entries.MAO억제제(항우울제, 항정신병제, 감정조절제, 항파킨슨제 등), 진해거: Do not take this medicine together with MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinson drugs, etc.), antitussives and expectorants, other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral medicines for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, medicines for allergies). Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with medicines for diabetes, gout, or arthritis, anticoagulants, steroids, barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.구역, 구토, 가려움, 건조하고 거친 피부, 통증성 관절부종, 위부불쾌감: If nausea, vomiting, itching, dry and rough skin, painful joint swelling, stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, rash, redness, loose stools, or symptoms such as menstruation coming earlier than expected, the flow gradually increasing, or bleeding continuing occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구역, 구토, 묽은 변 등이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 복용을 즉각 중단하고: If nausea, vomiting, or loose stools occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구역, 구토, 묽은 변, 설사 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고: If nausea, vomiting, loose stools, or diarrhoea occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.구역, 구토, 설사, 묽은 변, 위장관장애, 소화장애, 상복부통증, 저혈: If nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, loose stools, gastrointestinal disorder, digestive disorder, upper abdominal pain, low blood pressure, pulmonary oedema, dermatitis, a bad odour in sweat or breath, hair loss, or restlessness occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.다른 비스테로이드성 소염진통제, 아스피린, 고용량의 메토트렉세이트와 함께: Do not take this medicine together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, aspirin, or high-dose methotrexate. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with glucocorticoids, alcohol, digoxin, phenytoin, probenecid, sulfinpyrazone, sulfonylureas, diuretics, antihypertensives, ACE inhibitors, furosemide, lithium, low-dose methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (such as warfarin), or low-dose aspirin.
entries.드물게 쇽(호흡곤란, 혈압저하 등), 재생불량성빈혈, 용혈성빈혈, 무과립: If shock (difficulty breathing, a drop in blood pressure, etc.), blood disorders such as aplastic anaemia, haemolytic anaemia, agranulocytosis, granulocytopenia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, reduced platelet function (prolonged bleeding time), or eosinophilia occur, or peptic ulcer, gastrointestinal bleeding, perforation, ulcerative colitis, bloody stools, gastritis, pancreatitis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome (oculomucocutaneous syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), induction of an asthma attack, urticaria, eczema, purpura, occasionally rash or itching, rarely visual disturbances such as loss of vision or scotoma, aseptic meningitis, acute renal failure, oliguria, haematuria, proteinuria, a rise in BUN or blood creatinine, or hyperkalaemia occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Occasionally loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, or stomach discomfort may occur; very rarely thirst, stomatitis, abdominal bloating, or constipation; rarely jaundice, a rise in GOT, GPT, or AL-P, hearing loss, tinnitus, taste disturbance, a drop in blood pressure, a rise in blood pressure, palpitations, reduced urine output, generalised oedema and the accompanying shortness of breath, listlessness, or acute pulmonary oedema; occasionally periorbital oedema; and very rarely malaise, fever, or nosebleed.
entries.레보도파와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.에스트로겐을 포함한 경구용 피임제와 함: Do not take this medicine together with levodopa. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take it together with oral contraceptives containing oestrogen. Avoid tea containing tannin (for example green tea or black tea) while taking this medicine and just before or after taking it.
entries.만 12세 이하의 소아는 1회 권장용량을 4~6시간 마다 필요시 복용하십: For children aged 12 years or younger, take the recommended dose 1 time every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Refer to the approved labelling for the recommended doses by age group.
entries.만 15세 이상 성인은 1회 2캡슐씩, 만 7세 초과 ~ 만 15세 미만: Adults aged 15 years and older take 2 capsules as 1 dose, and those over 7 years and under 15 years take 1 capsule as 1 dose, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.만 8세 이상 및 성인은 1회 10mL, 만 24개월 이상~만 8세 미만: Adults and those aged 8 years and older take 10 mL as 1 dose, those aged 24 months and older and under 8 years take 7 mL as 1 dose, and those aged 3 months and older and under 24 months take 5 mL as 1 dose, 1 time a day.
entries.만 8세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1병씩, 만 24개월 이상~만 8세 미만은: Adults and those aged 8 years and older take 1 bottle as 1 dose, those aged 24 months and older and under 8 years take 1/2 bottle as 1 dose, those aged 12 months and older and under 24 months take 1/4 bottle as 1 dose, and those aged 3 months and older and under 12 months take 1/6 bottle as 1 dose, 1 time a day.
entries.매일 세잔 이상 정기적 음주자가 이 약 또는 다른 해열진통제를 복용할 때: If you regularly drink three or more glasses of alcohol every day, consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking this medicine or another antipyretic analgesic. It may cause liver damage. Very rarely, serious skin reactions that may be fatal, such as acute generalised exanthematous pustulosis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, and toxic epidermal necrolysis, have been reported. If a skin rash or another sign of a hypersensitivity reaction appears after taking this medicine, stop taking it immediately. Do not take more than the maximum daily dose of 4,000 mg of acetaminophen. It may cause liver damage. Do not take it together with other products containing acetaminophen.
entries.바르비탈계 약물, 삼환계 항우울제, 와파린, 리튬, 치아짓계이뇨제, 다른: Do not take this medicine together with barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, warfarin, lithium, thiazide diuretics, or other anti-inflammatory analgesics. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.발진 및 충혈되어 붉어지는 발적, 가려움, 구역 및 구토, 식욕부진, 변: If rash, redness with congestion, itching, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, oedema, or dizziness occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If, rarely, shock symptoms occur in which urticaria, oedema, or chest tightness appear right after taking it together with a pale complexion, cold hands and feet, cold sweat, or difficulty breathing, or if Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, asthma, generalised listlessness, liver dysfunction such as jaundice, or interstitial pneumonia in which a cough, breathlessness, difficulty breathing, or fever may appear occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진, 발적, 가려움, 구역, 구토, 식욕부진, 변비, 부종, 어지러움,: If rash, redness, itching, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, oedema, dizziness, anxiety, tremor, insomnia, rarely shock symptoms (urticaria, oedema, or chest tightness right after taking it together with a pale complexion, cold hands and feet, cold sweat, or difficulty breathing), Stevens-Johnson syndrome (oculomucocutaneous syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome) (severe symptoms such as high fever with rash and redness and burn-like blistering appearing on the skin all over the body and on the mucous membranes of the mouth or eyes), asthma, liver dysfunction (generalised listlessness, jaundice), or interstitial pneumonia (with cough, breathlessness, difficulty breathing, fever) occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Adults take 1 bottle as 1 dose, 2 times a day.
entries.쇽 증상(호흡곤란, 온몸이 붉어짐, 혈관부기, 두드러기 등), 천식발작,: If shock symptoms (difficulty breathing, reddening of the whole body, angioedema, urticaria, etc.), an asthma attack, thrombocytopenia, granulocytopenia, haemolytic anaemia (destruction of red blood cells), methaemoglobinaemia, reduced platelet function (prolonged bleeding time), cyanosis, hypersensitivity symptoms (facial swelling, sweating, low blood pressure), nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, gastrointestinal bleeding with long-term use, peptic ulcer, perforation, rash, an allergic reaction, Stevens-Johnson syndrome (oculomucocutaneous syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), a rise in AST, a rise in ALT, or fixed drug eruption occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 또는 경험자, 이 약 및 다른 해열진통제, 감기약 복용: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or a history of it, people who have experienced asthma when taking this medicine or another antipyretic analgesic or cold remedy, patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption, and infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are an infant or a child under 15 years of age who is infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza, have an allergic constitution, have experienced allergic symptoms such as fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, or itching caused by a medicine, have liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, or a gastroduodenal ulcer, are physically weak or have a high fever, have persistent or recurring stomach problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain, or have ulcer or bleeding problems, are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or are a child under 2 years of age. If your symptoms do not improve after taking it 5 to 6 times, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the specified dosage and administration.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 고칼슘혈증(혈액 중에 칼슘이 과잉으로 존재하는 상: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, hypercalcaemia (a condition in which there is an excess of calcium in the blood), sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause), infants under 3 months of age, and patients with kidney stones must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are an infant under 1 year of age, a child who gets a lot of sunlight and eats a normal diet, a patient with hyperoxaluria (a condition in which an excessive amount of oxalate is excreted in the urine), pregnant or may be pregnant, breastfeeding, a premature infant, an infant, a patient with gout, a patient with kidney stones or a history of them, or a patient with a predisposition to thrombosis. Follow the specified dosage and administration. When giving it to a child, give it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. It may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests and may turn the urine yellow, affecting clinical test values.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 다른 해열진통제 또는 감기약 복용 시 천식 경험자: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma when taking another antipyretic analgesic or cold remedy, and infants (nursing infants, newborns) under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are an infant or a child under 15 years of age who is infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza, a child under 2 years of age, have an allergic constitution, have experienced allergic symptoms (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), have liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, or a gastroduodenal ulcer, are elderly, are physically weak or have a high fever, have persistent or recurring stomach problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain, or have ulcer or bleeding problems, are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding, or have smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough with excessive phlegm, a cough that persists or recurs for 1 week or longer, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever, rash, or a persistent headache. Follow the specified dosage and administration. When giving it to a child, give it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If your symptoms do not improve after taking it about 5 to 6 times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 만 12개월 미만의 젖먹이는 이 약을 복용하지 마: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and nursing infants under 12 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have hyperoxaluria, are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, are a premature infant or an infant, have a gastrointestinal disease such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional enteritis, have cardiac or circulatory dysfunction, kidney disorder, hypoproteinaemia, gout, or kidney stones, or are deficient in folic acid. Follow the specified dosage and administration. If your symptoms do not improve after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. It may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests and may turn the urine yellow, affecting clinical test values.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이는 이 약을 복용하지 마십: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and nursing infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a nursing infant under 1 year of age, are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, are a premature infant or an infant, or are a patient with hypersensitivity to caramel or a history of it. If your symptoms do not improve after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. It may turn the urine yellow, affecting clinical test values. Children should take it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the specified dosage and administration.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and nursing infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or are a premature infant or an infant. Follow the specified dosage and administration. It may turn the urine yellow, affecting clinical test values. If your symptoms do not improve after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전에: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for oral administration only and do not use it for injection. If your symptoms do not improve after taking it for a certain period, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. It may turn the urine yellow, affecting clinical test values. Follow the specified dosage and administration.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 소화성궤양 환자, 심한 혈액 이상, 심한 간장애, 심한: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver disorder, severe kidney disorder, severe reduced cardiac function, or aspirin asthma (an asthma attack induced by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agents), or those with a history of these, must not take this medicine. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have liver disorder or a history of it, kidney disorder or a history of it, a history of peptic ulcer, blood abnormalities or a history of them, a bleeding tendency, abnormal cardiac function, a history of hypersensitivity, bronchial asthma, are elderly, are a child under 2 years of age, or are pregnant or breastfeeding. Without instructions from a doctor or pharmacist, do not take it for pain for 10 days or longer (adults) or 5 days or longer (children), and do not take it for fever for 3 days or longer.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 소화성궤양, 심한 혈액이상, 심한 간장애, 심한 신장애: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver disorder, severe kidney disorder, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure, or bronchial asthma, or those with a history of these, people who have experienced asthma, urticaria, or an allergic reaction to aspirin or another non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesic (including COX-2 inhibitors), patients being treated for pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery, and women who are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have a history of peptic ulcer, blood abnormalities or a history of them, a bleeding tendency (platelet dysfunction may occur), liver disorder or a history of it, kidney disorder or a history of it, cardiac insufficiency, high blood pressure, a history of hypersensitivity, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) or mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD), ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, are elderly or a child, or have stomach cancer. Considering the importance of the medication, either stop breastfeeding or stop the medication. Dizziness or fatigue may occur after taking this medicine, so take care when driving or operating machinery. When taking it long term for an acute condition, keep it to within 5 days as a rule.
entries.이 약은 감기로 인한 발열 및 동통(통증), 두통, 신경통, 근육통, 월: This medicine is used for fever and pain caused by a cold, headache, neuralgia, muscle pain, menstrual pain, sprain pain, toothache, joint pain, and rheumatic pain.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신 · 수유기, 병중 · 병후(병을 앓는 동안이나: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2, B6, and C when physical strength is reduced by physical fatigue, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or during or after an illness, to relieve the symptoms of neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation of the inside of the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, and dermatitis, and for beriberi, eye fatigue, and the supply of zinc.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신 및 수유기, 병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후의 체력: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2, and B6 and as a nutritional tonic when physical strength is reduced by physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, or during or after an illness.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신·수유기, 병중·병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2, and B6 when physical strength is reduced by physical fatigue, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or during or after an illness, to relieve the symptoms of neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation of the inside of the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, and dermatitis, and for beriberi and eye fatigue.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신ㆍ수유기, 병중ㆍ병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins A, D, E, B1, B2, B6, and C when physical strength is reduced by physical fatigue, pregnancy or breastfeeding, or during or after an illness, and during periods of growth and in old age, and to relieve dryness of the eyes, and for night blindness (difficulty seeing at night), poor development of the bones and teeth, and the prevention of rickets.
entries.이 약은 인후통, 오한, 발열, 두통, 관절통, 근육통 등 감기의 여러: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold, such as sore throat, chills, fever, headache, joint pain, and muscle pain.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제,: While taking this medicine, do not take antitussives and expectorants, other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines. Patients who are taking MAO inhibitors used for the treatment of depression or Parkinson's disease, or who are within 2 weeks of stopping them, must not take it. Before taking this medicine, people who are receiving medicines for diabetes, gout, or arthritis, anticoagulants, or steroids should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Patients who have been given barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
